evals.expected_output: Invokes debug in failure investigation mode, traces the empty-array failure to reduce without an initial value, distinguishes the thrown exception from the causal implementation choice, confirms the root cause, and remains read-only.
assertions: root cause identifies reduce without an initial accumulator for empty arrays
hypothesis ledger includes and rejects at least one plausible alternative or explains why none remains material
no implementation patch or mutation is performed

evals.prompt: Debug this login failure and test competing explanations. Fixture: evals/fixtures/competing-hypotheses.md

assertions: recent cache change is not treated as causal from recency alone
hypothesis ledger records supporting and contradicting evidence

assertions: missing partner access and redacted evidence are explicit

evals.prompt: Investigate why this test is flaky. Fixture: evals/fixtures/flaky-timing.md

assertions: passing rerun is not treated as resolution or confirmation
timer scheduling and fixed sleep are traced as the likely mechanism
root-cause status is LIKELY or CONFIRMED only when completeness supports it
post-fix verification targets deterministic timer control
